meta.title: Excellence Scholarship 2026
meta.description: A fictional premium scholarship program for students in Grades 4–10 — apply, track your application, and explore the syllabus.

hero.title: Your Potential Deserves an Opportunity.
hero.subtitle: One application and one rigorous examination open a pathway to recognition, support, and opportunity for students in Grades 4–10.

overview.heading: A stage for every deserving student
overview.body: The ScholarSphere Excellence Scholarship searches out meritorious students across Bangladesh — from busy district towns to quiet villages — and puts their achievement in front of everyone. The program is fictional, but its ambition is honest: make opportunity about merit, not luck.

items.title: Merit-only selection
items.body: One transparent entrance examination. No recommendations, no quotas, no hidden doors.

items.title: Real recognition
items.body: Published merit lists, certificates, and an awards ceremony for families and schools.

items.title: Support that continues
items.body: Awards of ৳5,000–৳20,000 plus study circles and mentoring through the program year.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.body: A guided seven-step application with a saved draft.

steps.title: Pay & verify
steps.body: The modest fee goes through (fictional) DemoPay.

steps.title: Sit the exam
steps.body: One written examination, set for your grade.

steps.title: Earn the stage
steps.body: Merit lists publish in January; awards follow.

syllabusTeaser.heading: Know exactly what to study
syllabusTeaser.body: Every grade has a published syllabus — subjects, marks, and topic lists — so preparation starts on day one.

eligibilityTeaser.heading: Are you eligible?
eligibilityTeaser.body: Students in Grades 4–10 at recognized institutions can apply. Check your grade's requirements before starting.

items.quote: The exam was the first time my result mattered outside my school. When my name appeared on the merit list, my whole family celebrated.
items.name: Ayesha Siddiqua
items.detail: Gold Award 2025, Grade 5 · Future Scholars Academy (fictional)

items.quote: I prepared from the published syllabus for three months. Nothing in the exam surprised me — that fairness is what I remember most.
items.name: Mehrab Hossain
items.detail: Gold Award 2025, Grade 8 · Rajshahi Mission School (fictional)

items.quote: The award money bought my books for the year, but the certificate is what hangs on our wall.
items.name: Tahmina Begum
items.detail: Gold Award 2025, Grade 10 · Dhanmondi Ideal High School (fictional)

leadership.heading: A message from the program director
leadership.quote: Every year I watch students walk into the examination hall as strangers and walk out as scholars. Our job is simply to keep that door open — and to keep it open for everyone.
leadership.name: Dr. Farhana Rahman

cta.title: Take the first step
cta.body: Applications for the 2026 cycle are open. The wizard saves your draft, so you can start now and finish whenever you're ready.
